interactions.assay: electron microscopy · qualitative binding
interactions.note: 3D cryo-electron microscopy reconstructions for multiple 2D class averages of the epitope specific mAb bound to CSP were determined at 6.1–10.9 Å resolution.  Reconstructions showed clear Fab signal, with additional signal shown extending from the tip of the Fv region corresponding to bound, but disordered CSP revealing that epitope recognition by the mAb encompasses additional interactions beyond peptide 21. Two of the classes observed by cryo-EM showed the mAb facing away from the peptide, but directly towards reconstruction density attributed to CSP.  Multiple classes were also obtained for two Fabs linked by their co-binding of the same CSP in close proximity, however the Fabs are too distant to interact with one another.

interactions.assay: electron microscopy · qualitative binding
interactions.note: 3D cryo-electron microscopy reconstructions for multiple 2D class averages of the epitope specific mAb bound to CSP were determined at 6.1–10.9 Å resolution.  Reconstructions showed clear Fab signal, with additional signal shown extending from the tip of the Fv region corresponding to bound, but disordered CSP revealing that epitope recognition by the mAb encompasses additional interactions beyond peptide 21. Two of the classes observed by cryo-EM showed the mAb facing away from the peptide, but directly towards reconstruction density attributed to CSP.  Multiple classes were also obtained for two Fabs linked by their co-binding of the same CSP in close proximity, however the Fabs are too distant to interact with one another.

interactions.assay: electron microscopy · qualitative binding
interactions.note: 3D cryo-electron microscopy reconstructions for multiple 2D class averages of the epitope specific mAb bound to CSP were determined at 6.1–10.9 Å resolution.  Reconstructions showed clear Fab signal, with additional signal shown extending from the tip of the Fv region corresponding to bound, but disordered CSP revealing that epitope recognition by the mAb encompasses additional interactions beyond peptide 21. Two of the classes observed by cryo-EM showed the mAb facing away from the peptide, but directly towards reconstruction density attributed to CSP.  Multiple classes were also obtained for two Fabs linked by their co-binding of the same CSP in close proximity, however the Fabs are too distant to interact with one another.

interactions.assay: electron microscopy · qualitative binding
interactions.note: 3D cryo-electron microscopy reconstructions for multiple 2D class averages of the epitope specific mAb bound to CSP were determined at 6.1–10.9 Å resolution.  Reconstructions showed clear Fab signal, with additional signal shown extending from the tip of the Fv region corresponding to bound, but disordered CSP revealing that epitope recognition by the mAb encompasses additional interactions beyond peptide 21. Two of the classes observed by cryo-EM showed the mAb facing away from the peptide, but directly towards reconstruction density attributed to CSP.  Multiple classes were also obtained for two Fabs linked by their co-binding of the same CSP in close proximity, however the Fabs are too distant to interact with one another.
